definition.name: moment_operator
definition.definition: The k-th moment operator M_mom^{(k)} for the GPS estimator encodes the k-th moment of the output: for any input state psi_sym on Sym^n(C^d), E[sigma_hat_v^{tensor k}] = tr_{1..n}(M_mom^{(k)} (psi_sym tensor I^{tensor k})). Explicitly, M_mom^{(k)} = d[n] * (d+n)^{up k} * integral |u><u|^{n+k} du * [debiasing factors], where (d+n)^{up k} = (d+n)(d+n+1)...(d+n+k-1) is the rising factorial. The first moment operator (k=1): M_mom^{(1)} = (1/n) X_{n+1} (Pi_sym^n tensor I). The second moment operator (k=2): M_mom^{(2)} = (1/n^2)(X_{n+2}X_{n+1} + (n+1,n+2))(Pi_sym^n tensor I^2) - Lower_mom.
